rules.name: Nearing Expiry Allocation Priority
rules.statement: Perishable items approaching shelf-life limits must be prioritized for allocation to new Order Requests over items with longer remaining shelf life.
rules.condition: When allocating stock for a new Order Request containing perishable goods
exceptions: If the prioritized item is flagged as 'nearing expiry' and the system is configured to reject such orders to prevent waste
rules.if_violated: The system must flag the allocation decision for manual review and delay the order assignment
rules.rationale: Prioritizing near-expiry items minimizes financial loss from unsellable goods and maintains brand reputation for quality.

parameters.name: Shelf-life safety margin
parameters.description: The percentage or time threshold defining an item as 'nearing expiry'

rules.name: Expiry-Flagged Item Rejection
rules.statement: An Order Request must not be assigned to a Store Partner if the primary fulfillment source contains any item flagged as 'nearing expiry'.
rules.condition: When validating inventory availability for an Order Request against a Store Partner
exceptions: If the Store Partner explicitly overrides the rejection via a manual quality validation process after confirming the item is still fit for sale
rules.if_violated: The system must automatically reject the Order Request and notify the customer of the inability to fulfill the order
rules.rationale: Delivering items nearing expiry risks quality failure, customer dissatisfaction, and potential regulatory non-compliance.

parameters.name: Nearing expiry threshold
parameters.description: The specific shelf-life limit that triggers an item flag

rules.name: Real-Time Inventory Deduction
rules.statement: Inventory quantities reserved by an automatic Order Request assignment must be immediately deducted from the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot.
rules.condition: Upon successful assignment of an Order Request to a Store Partner
exceptions: If the assignment is subsequently cancelled or the order is rejected before the fulfillment task begins
rules.if_violated: The system must prevent further Order Requests from being assigned to the same inventory units, leading to overselling
rules.rationale: Immediate deduction ensures accurate stock visibility and prevents selling items that are already committed to a specific order.

parameters.name: Inventory snapshot update latency
parameters.description: The maximum acceptable time for the deduction to reflect in the snapshot

rules.name: Expiry Alert Generation
rules.statement: The system must generate real-time alerts for inventory items approaching their shelf-life limits to prioritize fulfillment or trigger removal.
rules.condition: When an item's remaining shelf life falls below the configured safety margin
exceptions: During system maintenance windows where alerting is temporarily suspended
rules.if_violated: The business loses the opportunity to proactively manage waste, potentially leading to increased loss costs and quality issues
rules.rationale: Proactive alerts enable timely decision-making to either sell items before they expire or remove them from the catalog.

parameters.name: Alert trigger threshold
parameters.description: The time or percentage remaining before an alert is generated
